notes.title: GAME LAUNCH
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039480/848ae81609b752550c919bd4674ec9c3e2355ed2.png[/img]HEART 

CLICKER HAS RELEASED

Heart Clicker is a free-to-play clicker/idle game where you start with nothing and build your way up to a vast collection of hearts! Click to generate hearts, invest them in powerful upgrades, and watch your heart count soar. Can you unlock all the upgrades and achieve the ultimate heart collection?

Click to Generate Hearts: Start with zero hearts and click your way to a growing heart collection.

Upgrade Your Abilities: Spend your hearts on a variety of upgrades to increase your heart production.

Idle Progression: Earn hearts even when you're not actively playing. Come back to a wealth of hearts and new opportunities.

Unlock New Skins and Cosmetics: Customize your game by unlocking new heart skins and other exciting cosmetic items.

Charming Graphics: Enjoy cute and colorful visuals as you grow your heart collection.

Endless Fun: See how many hearts you can collect

Get new items as you play, items can be earned once per hour

Join the heart-collecting frenzy and see how far you can go in Heart Clicker!
